name: pumi-queue
description: A queue of commands that run one at a time, each after another pane is done, in a bar under the panes.

keep.label: Keep a finished job's pane
keep.desc: A job that ran in a pane of its own leaves that pane (and its output) open when it is done.

notify.label: Say when a job finishes
notify.desc: A notification when a job is over, as the OS gives one.
